criteria.description: The workbook opens and contains every required analysis sheet.
Every included paired-difference row is formula-linked and numerically correct.
Paired sample size and mean difference agree with the independent analysis.
Paired SD, SE, t statistic, and degrees of freedom agree with the independent analysis.
The two-sided paired-test p-value uses the declared method and agrees with the independent analysis.
Both 95% confidence-interval bounds agree with the independent paired analysis.
The planned paired sample size equals the declared normal-approximation result.
The chart remains bound to all paired-difference rows through formula-linked visualization cells.
The p-value and paired-difference visualization respond correctly to the declared measurement-value perturbation.
The decision summary applies the declared two-sided 0.05 rule to the calculated p-value.
All source observations and inclusion flags match the split-specific starting workbook.
Excluding one prespecified QC-flagged pair updates n, inference, and decision while preserving its raw measurements, planned sample size, and full-source chart binding.
Penalty for independent-group substitution, one-tailed inference, broken pairing, or source edits.
